description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle JDBC data source, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including converting photo BLOB storage to bytea.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC data source and driver with PostgreSQL equivalents. Update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect for Azure Database for PostgreSQL, and migrate Oracle-specific SQL and schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible forms. Convert Oracle BLOB photo storage to PostgreSQL bytea. Use Managed Identity for database authentication instead of plaintext credentials.
